title: Criminal Case Processing in Metropolitan Courts, 1976
description:
In 1977 the National Center for State Courts, in
 cooperation with the National Conference of Metropolitan Courts, began
 a research and demonstration project on the delay in processing criminal
 cases in major metropolitan
 courts. The objectives were (1) to determine the scope and extent of
 the delay in such courts, (2) to identify factors associated with the delay,
 and (3) to suggest and ultimately test techniques that might work to
 reduce the delay. The variables include geographic location, disposition
 type, most serious charge against the defendant, and dates of arrest,
trial, disposition, and sentencing.
